name: movfun_order_stats
expr: mx = movmax(J, 3); mn = movmin(J, 3); md3 = movmedian(J, 3); md2 = movmedian(J, 2); ndn = movmedian(N, 2); lx = movmax(L, 3); ln = movmin(L, 3); lmd = movmedian(L, 3);
comment: movmax/movmin/movmedian on integer/logical. MATLAB PRESERVES the class for these order statistics: movmax/movmin int->int (exact) & logical->logical; movmedian int->int with ROUND-half-away (1.5->2, 4.5->5, -1.5->-2) but logical->DOUBLE (0.5 median). Window 3 unless w2. Fingerprints read int/logical via double(...); lmd (logical movmedian) is already double. bugs/stats/movfun-order-stats.md.
